title: Llama waving hello
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="24" ry="16" fill="#f2d9a8"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d="M38 70 Q34 50 38 36 L48 36 Q44 52 50 70 Z" fill="#f7e4bd"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="30" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#f7e4bd"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="33" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#e8c48f"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="16" rx="3" ry="7" fill="#f2d9a8"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="16" rx="3" ry="7" fill="#f2d9a8"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="17" rx="1.5" ry="4" fill="#d98f8f"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="17" rx="1.5" ry="4" fill="#d98f8f"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="27" r="2.2" fill="#3a2f4a"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="27" r="2.2" fill="#3a2f4a"/>
  <!-- nostrils and smile -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="32" r="1" fill="#8a5a3a"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="32" r="1" fill="#8a5a3a"/>
  <path d="M33 36 Q36 38 40 36" stroke="#8a5a3a" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- fluffy neck fluff -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="44" r="5" fill="#fff4dc"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="46" r="5" fill="#fff4dc"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="52" r="5" fill="#fff4dc"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="38" y="84" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#e8c48f"/>
  <rect x="52" y="84" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#e8c48f"/>
  <rect x="60" y="84" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#e8c48f"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="66" rx="5" ry="7" fill="#fff4dc"/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d="M66 66 Q78 62 82 46" stroke="#e8c48f" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- waving hoof/hand -->
  <circle cx="83" cy="43" r="6" fill="#f7e4bd"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="38" r="2" fill="#e8c48f"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="37" r="2" fill="#e8c48f"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="41" r="2" fill="#e8c48f"/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d="M36 68 Q28 72 26 80" stroke="#e8c48f" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- wave lines -->
  <path d="M88 30 Q92 28 94 31" stroke="#ffd76a" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M86 24 Q90 21 93 23" stroke="#ffd76a" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
